steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Create the fundamental file layout for the web application, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files.

steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Set up the application's core metadata in app-meta.json, including its name and project type.

steps.title: Scaffold HTML Document
steps.description: Create the basic HTML5 document structure in index.html, including meta tags, title, and body.

steps.title: Integrate Tailwind CSS
steps.description: Add the Tailwind CSS CDN link to the head section of index.html for modern, utility-first styling.

steps.title: Apply Base Styling and Layout
steps.description: Use Tailwind CSS classes to style the body and app container, centering the content on the page.

steps.title: Create Main Heading
steps.description: Add an h1 element with the 'Hello, World!' message, styled for prominence using Tailwind CSS.

steps.title: Add Introductory Paragraph
steps.description: Include a descriptive paragraph below the main heading to welcome the user to the AI-generated app.

steps.title: Link Custom Stylesheet
steps.description: Ensure the style.css file is correctly linked in the HTML document, even if it's initially empty.

steps.title: Link JavaScript File
steps.description: Include the script.js file at the end of the body in index.html to load interactive logic.

steps.title: Implement Client-Side Scripting
steps.description: Add a simple DOMContentLoaded event listener in script.js to confirm the application has loaded.

steps.title: Define API Schema
steps.description: Create api_schema.json, specifying that this application does not require a backend service.

steps.title: Final Project Assembly
steps.description: Review and combine all generated files into a cohesive web project.

steps.title: Building helloworldapp
steps.description: The 'Hello World' web application is now complete and ready for deployment or further development.
